grid.cell_assignment: floor((x-origin_x)/3000), floor((origin_y-y)/3000); use projected coordinates, not WGS84 envelopes

landscape.method: Exact counts and statistics of original 30 m cell centers within the supplied CONUS geometry; no categorical interpolation or source overview sampling.
limitations: National cells describe 3 km context, not a 200 m scene.
Water fraction does not identify river centerlines; small channels may be unresolved at 30 m.
Riparian and desert tags follow EVT attributes, not a hydrologic or climate classification.
Terrain descriptors are rendering heuristics, not official landforms.
No fire spread, risk, wind, structures or inferred ignition state is supplied.

method: Static source inputs and landscape context. Scene animation is illustrative, not fire-spread inference.
